item.title: Japan Beyond Tokyo: 7 Hidden Destinations That Most Tourists Miss
item.description: Skip the tourist crowds and explore Japan's lesser-known gems. From the art islands of the Seto Inland Sea to the volcanic landscapes of Kagoshima, these destinations offer authentic experiences.
